_about: Catalogue of techniques per school, the source of the generated block of db_v1_init.sql
(tools/catalog-sql.py; a test checks they match). Collected from public web pages on 2026-10-25
(each section's sources). Meanings (en/fr) are rough glosses, to be reviewed by a teacher.
Gyokushin and Kumogakure: no public source names their techniques yet.
